title: DAML project file (daml.yaml)
description: Schema for daml.yaml — the project file consumed by the daml assistant.

sdk-version.description: DAML SDK version this project pins to (e.g. "2.9.0" or "3.4.0"). The daml assistant uses this to resolve damlc.

daml-version.description: Alias for sdk-version on newer SDK installs (DPM).

name.description: Package name (used as the DAR name).

source.description: Path to the DAML source root (relative to this file). Usually "daml" or "src/main/daml".

dependencies.description: DAR dependencies (paths or names of standard libraries).

build-options.description: Extra arguments forwarded to damlc build.

parties.description: Parties allocated by daml start in the local sandbox.

module-prefixes.description: Mapping from package id to module prefix (used for collision avoidance).

sandbox-options.description: Arguments forwarded to daml sandbox by daml start.
